blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Spatial intelligence lets an agent perceive and act in the physical world, and many of its judgments must be made at interaction rates: which spatial relation holds, how far an object is, or where to place it. Vision-language models (VLMs) produce these answers by free-form text generation, paying for autoregressive decoding and answer parsing even though the output space is compact: one of a few options, a scalar, or a 2D point. In light of this, we introduce MJev-Spatial, a System 1 multimodal decision model that tackles all three types of spatial understanding tasks within a unified classification framework. Specifically, MJev-Spatial treats each candidate as a class and scores it using the backbone's pretrained query and key projections, without adding parameters. The candidates are the given options for choice tasks, or value bins and image regions refined through coarse-to-fine classification for numerical and point prediction, respectively. At inference, each classification decision takes a single forward pass and generates no answer tokens. To train on heterogeneous spatial data efficiently, we supervise all coarse-to-fine stages jointly with teacher forcing in one forward pass, and combine this with length-aware global batching and cross-GPU load balancing, raising training throughput by 30.8% over the original batching strategy. Built on Qwen3.5-4B and trained on 12.3M question-answer pairs converted from existing spatial datasets, MJev-Spatial achieves the highest overall score (65.64%) among eight tested models, ranks first on seven of twelve benchmarks, and outperforms its unmodified autoregressive base model on all twelve, while running 2.5 times faster than the fastest autoregressive baseline and 5.6 times faster than the base model.

Vision-language models (VLMs) 通过自由格式的文本生成来生成这些答案,支付自旋解码和解答解析,即使输出空间是紧凑的:少数选项之一,是平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面 有鉴于此,我们引入了MJev-Spatial,一种系统1的多模式决定模型,在统一的分类框架内处理所有三类空间理解任务. 具体来说,MJev-Spatial将每个考生视为一个类,并使用骨干预先训练的查询和关键预测来评分,而不增加参数. 候选人是选择任务的指定选项,或者通过粗细的分类分别对数值和分数预测进行精细的分数和图像区域进行精细的估价. 推论,每个分类决定都采取单一前传,不产生答题符. 为了高效地培训不同的空间数据,我们对所有粗糙的到精细的阶段进行联合监督,教师在一次前行中强迫进行,并将这与长视全球分批和跨GPU负载平衡结合起来,使培训吞吐量比原来的分批战略提高了30.8%。 MJev-Sparadial以Quen3.5-4B为主,并接受从现有空间数据集转换而来12.3M问答对等的训练,在被测试的8个模型中取得了最高的总分(65.64%),在12个基准中的7个中排名第一,并且在所有12个基准中都超过了其未经修改的自递式基准模型,同时运行速度快于最快自递式基准,快于基准模型的5.6倍.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Spatial intelligence involves perceiving and reasoning about the geometry and spatial relationships of objects, which enables agents to navigate their surroundings and interact with the physical world ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) .
Many of these interactions require timely spatial judgments.
Vision-language models (VLMs) support these capabilities by answering spatial questions grounded in visual observations.
Such questions may require selecting an option that describes a spatial relation ( Ray et al., 2025 ; Tong et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , estimating a numerical quantity such as distance ( Cai et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2025b ) , or identifying a point for object placement ( Zhou et al., 2025a ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
空间智能涉及对物体几何学和空间关系的感知和推理,这使得物剂能够通航其周围环境并和物理世界互动(Chen等,2024;Cheng等,2024.).
其中许多相互作用需要及时的空间判断。
视觉语言模型(VLMs)通过回答基于视觉观测的空间问题来支持这些能力.
这些问题可能需要选择一个描述空间关系的选项(Ray等人,2025年;Tong等人,2024年;Fu等人,2024年;Yang等人,2026年),估算距离等数值(Cai等人,2026年;Yang等人,2025年a;Yang等人,2025年b),或确定物体放置点(Zhou等人,2025年a; 袁等,2024;宋等,2025;程等,2025.

blocks.en:
To produce these spatial predictions, many existing VLMs retain their pretrained autoregressive text-generation capabilities ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ; Deitke et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2025a ) .
Each option, numerical value, or image location is therefore represented as a token sequence that the model is trained to reproduce.
This couples learning the spatial answer with learning its textual form, including formatting and boilerplate when present, introducing supervision beyond the task-relevant prediction itself.
At inference, the model must generate the answer tokens sequentially, after which the resulting text must be parsed to recover the spatial prediction, adding decoding and parsing overhead.
This motivates a System 1 approach to spatial understanding: using pretrained visual and linguistic knowledge to make spatial judgments directly.
Jev provides a precedent for this approach by returning probabilities over specified candidates without generating answer text ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) .
At the same time, we observe that all three common spatial output types can be represented as finite candidate sets: answer options are already finite, while numerical values and image locations can be discretized within a specified range and resolution.
Building on these insights, we introduce MJev-Spatial , a multimodal decision model specifically tailored to spatial understanding.
blocks.zh:
为了产生这些空间预测,许多已存在的VLM保留了它们经过预先训练的自转式文本生成能力(Chen等,2024;Cheng等,2024;Deitke等,2025;Yuan等,2024;Zhou等,2025a).
因此,每个选项,数字值或图像位置都作为符号序列来表示,该模型被训练来复制.
这对夫妇学习空间答案,学习其文字形式,包括格式化和现时的锅炉板,在与任务相关的预测本身之外引入监督.
推论,模型必须相继生成解答符,之后所生成的文本必须被解析以恢复空间预测,并添加解码和解析高空.
这激励了系统1对空间理解的方法:利用预先训练的视觉和语言知识直接作出空间判断.
Jev为这种做法提供了一个先例,在不生成答案文本的情况下将特定候选人的概率还原(TypeSafe AI, 2026.).
与此同时,我们观察到,所有三种共同的空间输出类型都可以作为有限度的候选组合表示:答案选项已经是有限度的,而数字值和图像位置可以在指定的范围和分辨率范围内被盘点.
基于这些见解,我们引入了MJev-Spatial,一种专门针对空间理解的多式联运决策模式。

blocks.en:
MJev-Spatial unifies the three output types by casting prediction as classification over finite candidate sets.
Each class represents a supplied answer option, a numerical bin, or an image region, depending on the task.
Selecting a class gives the chosen option, predicts which bin contains the target value, or predicts which region contains the target point.
To choose among these classes, MJev-Spatial encodes their descriptions together with the observation and question, then reuses the final attention layer’s pretrained query and key projections to compute class scores.
A softmax over these scores gives the class probabilities, without additional prediction heads or trainable parameters.
At inference, each classification decision scores all its candidates in one forward pass.
Furthermore, to obtain fine-grained values and coordinates without evaluating a large number of classes at once, we subdivide the selected numerical bin or image region and classify again.
Numerical prediction uses up to two stages; single-point prediction uses three stages, re-encoding the selected image crop before each later decision to recover local visual detail.
The final selection is decoded to a numerical value or image coordinates.
Conditional tree expansion evaluates multiple region paths to extend the same trained point predictor to multiple points without additional training.
blocks.zh:
MJev-Spaceal通过在有限的候选组合上将预测作为分类来统一这三种产出类型。
每个类代表一个已提供的答案选项,一个数字框,或一个图像区域,视任务而定.
选择类会给出所选选项,预测哪个宾包含目标值,或者预测哪个区域包含目标点.
为了在这些类中进行选择,MJev-Spatial将他们的描述与观察和提问一起编码,然后再用最后的注意力层预先训练的查询和关键预测来计算类分.
超过这些分数的软马克给出了类概率,没有额外的预测头或可训练参数.
推论,每个叙级决定都给所有候选人打分。
此外,为了在不同时评估大量类别的情况下获得精细的数值和坐标,我们再细分选定的数字框或图像区域并再次分类。
数值预测最多使用两个阶段;单点预测使用三个阶段,在以后每次决定恢复局部视觉细节之前重新编码所选图像收成.
最后的选择被解码为数字值或图像坐标.
有条件的树扩张评价了多个区域路径,将同一训练有素的点预测器扩展至多个点而无需额外的训练.

blocks.en:
Numerical and point prediction can require multiple supervised stages, with new image crops introduced between point decisions.
Ground-truth answers determine the target classes and crops, allowing all stages to be jointly supervised in one teacher-forced causal forward pass.
We average the stage cross-entropy losses per question so that a multi-stage example does not receive greater weight than a one-stage choice.
Global length grouping and cross-GPU load balancing address the padding and workload imbalance caused by different sequence lengths and crop counts while preserving optimizer-batch membership.
An audited conversion pipeline supplies 12.3M QA from existing spatial annotations for full-parameter training of the retained language backbone.

blocks.en:
Built on Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , MJev-Spatial achieves the highest overall score among eight evaluated models, leads on seven benchmarks, and outperforms its unmodified autoregressive base model on all twelve.
Across all twelve benchmarks, it achieves 2.5 × \times and 5.6 × \times speedups over the fastest autoregressive baseline and the base model, respectively.
Separate studies examine candidate scoring, visual refinement, numerical discretization, and training execution.
The readout and refinement studies assess how candidate scoring with pretrained projections and crop re-encoding contribute to prediction quality and computational cost; the numerical study shows that coarser length discretization can reduce prediction error despite its lower resolution.
Global length grouping and cross-GPU load balancing further improve training throughput by 30.8% over the original batching strategy.
blocks.zh:
建于Quen3.5-4B上 (Quen Team, 2026),MJev-Spatial在被评价的8个模型中取得了最高的总分,领先了7个基准,并且在所有12个模型上都超过了其未经修改的自递式基准模型.
在所有12个基准中,它分别实现了2.5×分时和5.6×分时的速度超过最快的自转基线和基准模型。
单独研究审查考生评分、视觉改进、数字盘化和培训执行。
阅读和完善研究评估了候选人通过预先训练的预测和作物再编码的得分如何有助于预测质量和计算成本;数字研究显示,纵有分辨率较低,缩短长度的光碟化可以减少预测出错。
全球长度分组和跨GPU负载比原来的分批策略进一步提高了30.8%的培训吞吐量.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: (1) We propose a novel System 1 paradigm for spatial intelligence, unifying option selection, numerical estimation, and image pointing through direct classification over finite candidate sets. (2) Building on this paradigm, we develop MJev-Spatial and a unified training recipe, using pretrained attention projections for candidate scoring and joint supervision across spatial tasks and refinement stages. (3) Across twelve spatial benchmarks, MJev-Spatial achieves the highest mean score among eight evaluated models and a 5.6 × \times speedup over its autoregressive base model, Qwen3.5-4B.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Jev motivates predicting over declared answer spaces instead of generating unrestricted answer text ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) .
Jev-Omni extends this interface to multimodal inputs ( akhilaaa3, 2026 ) , while KEV implements candidate scoring with learned query and key projections ( Palmer, 2026 ) . Yu and Yao (2026) and hr98w (2026) study direct decisions and shared-context execution; FBddcz and EmbodiedJev contributors (2026) applies decision interfaces to skill and action selection.
Concurrent work, VideoJev, uses a shared candidate scorer for temporal grounding and video question answering, with cached and joint inference for queries about the same video ( Zhu et al., 2026a ) .
Visual Jev reads candidate-token probabilities from the existing language-model head and finds no consistent accuracy advantage from an added typed head in its matched control.
MJev-Spatial instead scores contextual candidate content with the backbone’s final-layer query and key projections and trains all output types with the same candidate-classification objective.
Our matched readout experiments show competitive quality and lower training cost for this design, with task-dependent tradeoffs ( Section 4.3 ).
The earlier Molmo2-ER-based MJev-Spatial prototype used LoRA and an added decision head ( Fang et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2022 ) .
The present model uses Qwen3.5-4B and trains all retained language parameters.
Backbone efficiency is also studied through pruning and quantization, joint low-rank and sparsity optimization, and adaptive execution ( Zhou et al., 2026a ; Zhou et al., 2026b ; Zhou et al., 2025b ; Zhou et al., 2025c ) .
blocks.zh:
Jev激励人们预测所宣布的答案空间,而不是生成不受限制的答案文本(TypeSafe AI,2026.).
Jev-Omni将这个接口扩展至多模式输入(akhilaaa3, 2026 ),而KEV则以学到的查询和关键预测执行候选评分(Palmer, 2026 ). Yu and Yao (2026)和hr98w (2026)研究直接决定和共享文本执行;FBddcz和EmformJev贡献者(2026)将决定界面应用于技能和动作选择.
同时期作品"VideoJev"使用共享的候选计分器进行时间定位和视频提问回答,对同一视频的询问进行缓存和联合推论(Zhu等,2026a).
视觉 Jev从现有的语言模型头读取候选人的概率,在其匹配的控制中发现一个被添加的打字头没有一致的准确性优势.
MJev-Spatial则用主干的最后一层查询和关键预测对背景候选内容进行评分,并以相同的候选分类目标对所有产出类型进行培训。
我们的对等读取试验显示,这种设计具有竞争力,培训费用也较低,而且要进行任务取舍(第4.3节)。
更早的以Molmo2-ER为主的MJev-Spatial原型使用了LORA和一个附加的决定头(Fang等,2026;Hu等,2022.).
本型号使用Quen3.5-4B并列车全部保留了语言参数.
后骨效率也通过挤压和量化、联合低等和痉挛优化以及适应性执行来研究(周等,2026a; 周克等,2026b;周克等,2025b;周克等,2025c.

blocks.en:
Class-aware adaptation provides a complementary route to efficient vision-language classification.
AWT enriches class descriptions and combines augmented views through entropy-based weighting and optimal transport ( Zhu et al., 2024a ) .
Self-TPT uses self-supervised prompt adaptation for new classes to avoid costly per-image optimization at inference ( Zhu et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh:
具有阶级意识的适应为高效的视觉语言分类提供了补充途径.
AWT丰富了类描述,并结合了通过 en基加权和优化迁移(Zhu等,2024a.)来增强视野.
Self-TPT采用自我监督的即时适应新类来避免推想中成本高昂的活像优化(Zhu等,2026b.).

blocks.en:
Broader multimodal research covers visual reasoning ( Qin et al., 2025 ) , retrieval ( Qin et al., 2024 ) , and multimodal generation ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Qin et al., 2026 ; Zhong et al., 2025 ) .
Video understanding further requires temporal localization ( Zhu et al., 2024b ; Zhu et al., 2026c ) and efficient processing of long or streaming observations ( Li et al., 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2026a ) .
SpatialVLM and SpatialRGPT learn spatial relations and numerical answers from spatial supervision ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) , while Molmo, RoboPoint, and RoboRefer support pointing through coordinate text ( Deitke et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2025a ) .
Alternative interfaces can ground predictions more directly.
MolmoPoint selects visual patches and refines locations through a sequence of specialized grounding tokens ( Clark et al., 2026 ) .
MJev-Spatial uses one candidate-classification mechanism for options, numerical values, and points, with task-specific candidates supplying the output structure.
Its multi-point extension expands conditional classification paths rather than generating a variable-length coordinate string.

blocks.en:
Representing continuous predictions with discrete classes is established in computer vision.
DORN formulates monocular depth estimation as ordinal regression over logarithmically spaced depth intervals ( Fu et al., 2018 ) .
Our length representation also uses logarithmically spaced coarse intervals, followed by linear refinement, but its intervals are candidate descriptions scored by a shared language backbone.
Counts and angles retain their own ranges and discretization schemes.
Visual search methods such as V ∗ refine image regions to recover details needed for answering ( Wu and Xie, 2024 ) .
Video-o3 similarly acquires evidence iteratively in long videos, interleaving clue seeking with inspection of relevant segments ( Zeng et al., 2026b ) .
In MJev-Spatial, region selection itself is supervised as classification, and re-encoded crops provide the evidence for subsequent decisions.
blocks.zh:
计算机视觉中建立了带有离散类的连续预测。
DORN在对数相距深度间隔上形成单向深度估计为正向回归(Fu等,2018年).
我们的长度表示也采用对数相间距粗细相间,再作线性改进,但其间隔是共用语言主干线所得的候选描述.
计数和取角保留了自己的射程和圆盘化方案.
V *等视觉搜索方法精炼图像区域取回解答所需的细节(Wu and Xie, 2024).
Video-o3同样在长视频中反复地获取证据,与相关片段的检查相互连接寻找线索(Zeng等,2026b.).

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
MJev-Spatial takes visual observations, a spatial question, and task-specific candidates as input.
Following Jev ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) , it predicts by selecting candidates rather than generating text.
We first explain how one classification framework handles answer options, numerical values, and image locations, including coarse-to-fine refinement and multi-point prediction.
We then describe the shared model architecture and the training recipe.
blocks.zh:
MJev-Spatial以视觉观测,空间问题,和任务特定候选作为输入.
在Jev(TypeSafe AI,2026)之后,它通过选择候选人而不是生成文本来预测.
我们首先解释一个分类框架如何处理答案选项、数值和图像位置,包括粗细的精细化和多点预测。
然后,我们描述共同的示范架构和培训方法。

Each candidate is a possible answer for the current decision.
For a choice question, it is one of the supplied options; for a numerical or point question, it identifies an interval or region in which the target is predicted to lie.
This lets all three output types use the same candidate-classification rule.

Numerical prediction must cover a wide range of values while retaining useful precision.

blocks.en:
A single greedy path returns one location.
To recover several locations with the same trained model, we expand multiple paths and assign each final cell the product of its conditional probabilities along the path.
Together, these probabilities form a spatial map in which separated high-probability regions can yield multiple predictions.
We retain cells above a fixed threshold relative to the map’s peak, group connected cells, and return the center of the highest-probability cell in each group.
The number of output points is determined by the resulting groups.
This requires no additional training or learned stop decision.
Full expansion visits 91 decision nodes and yields 729 cells; the evaluation decoder prunes low-probability root branches to reduce this cost.
Traversal and component extraction use model predictions only, with no target masks or true point counts. Section A.4 gives the fixed decoding rules, and Section F.2 evaluates their quality and computational tradeoffs.

blocks.en: 3.2 Model Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.2 示范建筑

blocks.en:
The framework in Section 3.1 defines the candidate classes and refinement rules; a model must still determine which class is supported by the visual observation and question.
Following Jev ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) , we adapt a pretrained VLM to make these decisions.
Its contextual representations draw on visual and linguistic knowledge acquired during large-scale pretraining, providing a basis for interpreting the scene and evaluating possible answers.
We build on this capacity by formulating classification as matching a decision representation with candidate representations.
Our design reuses both pretrained features and matching projections, giving the classifier a pretrained initialization without an additional prediction head. Figure 3 illustrates the candidate sequence and the representations used for scoring.
blocks.zh:
第3.1节中的框架界定了候选类别和完善规则;一个模式仍必须确定哪类得到视觉观察和问题的支持。
继Jev(TypeSafe AI,2026)之后,我们改用经过预训的VLM来做出这些决定.
其背景表述借鉴了大规模预训期间获得的视觉和语言知识,为解释场景和评价可能的答案提供基础.
我们以这种能力为基础,制定分类办法,将决策代表与候选人代表相匹配。
我们的设计再利用预先训练的特性和匹配的预测,使分类器有一个预先训练的初始化,而不需要额外的预测头. 图3显示候选人的顺序和评分所用的表述。

blocks.en:
Each candidate is expressed as text: choice tasks retain the supplied option content, numerical tasks specify values or intervals with their units, and pointing tasks name cells relative to the current image region, such as “top-left” or “center”.
These descriptions provide the candidate content that the VLM contextualizes with the observation and question.

这些描述提供了备选内容,供VLM与观察和问题结合。

blocks.en:
We instantiate MJev-Spatial with Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) .
Its vision encoder and merger convert the images into visual tokens, which are encoded together with the question, preceding refinement history, and current candidate descriptions in a causal sequence.
Each candidate description ends with an option-end marker, and the complete candidate list ends with a decision marker.
After the first 31 language layers, the hidden state at each option-end marker represents that candidate in the context of the observation, question, and preceding candidates.
The hidden state at the decision marker incorporates the full candidate set and serves as the decision representation.
The markers reuse existing vocabulary entries, so no new embeddings are introduced. Section A.2 gives the exact sequence layout.

blocks.en:
All candidates for a decision are evaluated in the same forward pass.
We gather only the decision and option-end states before projection, and remove the unused value, gate, output, and feed-forward paths of the final layer.
All retained language parameters are trainable; the vision encoder and merger remain frozen, as described in the training recipe below.
Because candidate representations are causally ordered, training deterministically shuffles options, while evaluation follows the benchmark’s specified ordering protocol.

blocks.en: 3.3 Training Recipe
blocks.zh: 3.3 培训手段

blocks.en:
We convert existing spatial annotations into 12.3M training QA and supervise all refinement stages of each question in one language-backbone forward pass.
Length grouping and cross-GPU load balancing reduce padding and workload imbalance.

长度分组和跨GPU负载平衡可减少铺垫和工作量不平衡.

blocks.en:
Our training corpus contains 12.3M question–answer pairs converted from RefSpatial ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) , SAT ( Ray et al., 2025 ) , SenseNova-SI ( Cai et al., 2026 ) , VSI-590K-image ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , and VST-P ( Yang et al., 2025b ) .
The training data cover multiple-choice spatial question answering (7.1M QA), point localization (3.5M QA), length estimation (1.6M QA), angle estimation (120K QA), and counting (38K QA).
These totals count original QA before expansion into decision stages.
See Table 7 in Appendix B for the source-by-task breakdown, with conversion and validation details provided in the same appendix.

Every supervised decision uses categorical cross-entropy over its current candidate set.
A choice question has one target class, whereas numerical and point questions can contain a sequence of target classes; point refinement also introduces image crops between stages.
The annotated answer determines the complete target path and any corresponding crops before training.
We serialize the stages in causal order, with each target choice and any subsequent crop placed after the corresponding decision position.
Earlier decisions therefore cannot attend to later choices or crops, while teacher forcing allows all stage losses to be evaluated in a single language-backbone forward pass.
At inference, the next candidates and crop depend on the model’s current selection, so the stages are evaluated sequentially.

Averaging over stages gives each original QA equal total weight, so a three-stage point counts no more than a one-stage choice.

blocks.en:
Joint supervision removes the need for a separate language-backbone training pass at each refinement stage, but questions still require different amounts of computation.
In particular, point examples add two image crops, while choice and numerical examples have different candidate lengths and stage counts.
Padding dissimilar sequences wastes work, and assigning unequal work to GPUs delays synchronization.
We sort the expanded sequences within each global optimizer batch by length to form similar-length microbatches.
A longest-work-first assignment ( Graham, 1969 ) then distributes the microbatches across GPUs, using a cost that accounts for padded sequence length and visual-token work.
This combines length grouping with cross-GPU load balancing while preserving the questions in each optimizer batch and their weights in Equation 7 .
Every QA remains an independent causal row: packing different questions together would additionally require isolation of Qwen’s Gated DeltaNet states ( Yang et al., 2025c ) .
The assignment rule and distributed normalization are specified in Section C.3 .
blocks.zh:
联合监督消除了在每个改进阶段需要单独的语言后骨培训通行证,但问题仍然需要不同的计算量。
特别是点例增加了两个图像收成,而选择和数字例则有不同的候选长度和相位计数.
铺设相异的序列会使废物工作生效,并将不平等的工作分配给GPU延迟同步.
我们按长度对每批全球优化器的扩展序列进行排序,以形成相近长的微电池。
工作时间最长的第一任务(Graham,1969年),然后将微管分配到GPU,使用成本计算出加长序列长度和可视化接力活.
这结合了长度分组和跨GPU负载平衡,同时在方程式7中保留每个优化批次中的问题及其重量.
每一份质量保证书都是独立的因果行:将不同的问题放在一起,还需要对Quen的Gated DeltaNet状态进行隔离(Yang等人,2025c)。
C.3节规定了分配规则和分布式正常化。

blocks.en:
Given the scale of our expanded training corpus, we adopt full-parameter fine-tuning of the language backbone, although parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) is also applicable ( Zhou et al., 2025d ; Zhou et al., 2026c ; Zhou et al., 2025e ; Zhou et al., 2025f ; Zhou et al., 2026d ) .
The final configuration uses eight GPUs, a per-device microbatch size of eight, and eight gradient accumulation steps, yielding a global batch size of 512.
We use AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) with learning rates of 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} for the backbone and 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} for the readout.
Language computation uses BF16, while trainable weights, gradients, optimizer states, and candidate scoring remain in FP32.
The vision encoder and merger are frozen. Section C.2 provides the complete configuration, and Section 4.4 evaluates the scheduling improvements under controlled conditions.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en:
We first compare the final MJev-Spatial model with seven autoregressive VLMs on spatial prediction quality and inference latency.
Controlled pilot experiments then compare candidate scorers, crop re-encoding and feature reuse, numerical discretization, and multi-point decoding.
Finally, we measure how length grouping and cross-GPU load balancing affect training throughput.

最后,我们衡量长度分组和跨GPU负载平衡对培训吞吐量的影响。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
MJev-Spatial is compared with seven generative baselines: Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) , InternVL3.5-8B ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , Molmo2-ER ( Fang et al., 2026 ) , Spatial-SSRL ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , SenseNova-SI ( Cai et al., 2026 ) , and SpatialThinker ( Batra et al., 2025 ) .
Our evaluation covers the popular SAT ( Ray et al., 2025 ) , CV-Bench ( Tong et al., 2024 ) , BLINK ( Fu et al., 2024 ) , MMSI-Bench ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , RefSpatial-Bench ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) , Where2Place ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) , Point-Bench ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) , RoboSpatial VQA and pointing ( Song et al., 2025 ) , ERQA ( Gemini Robotics Team et al., 2025 ) , EmbSpatial ( Du et al., 2024 ) , and VSI-Bench ( Yang et al., 2025d ) .

For model-design ablations, we use a fixed 72K-QA mixture of 25K SAT choice questions, 22K VST-P length questions, and 25K RefSpatial point questions to reduce training cost while providing sufficient supervision for meaningful comparisons.
Each model is trained for 2.2K updates using the same optimizer, learning-rate schedule, and image-token budgets.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Result
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Our main evaluation tests the central premise of MJev-Spatial: a System 1 decision model can make accurate spatial judgments with low inference latency.
We therefore assess prediction quality and latency jointly, comparing MJev-Spatial with seven autoregressive VLMs.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要评价测试了MJev-Spatial的中心前提:一个System 1决策模型能够以低推论延迟进行准确的空间判断.
因此,我们联合评估预测质量和延迟性,将MJev-Spaceal与7个自相递减的VLM进行比较。

blocks.en:
MJev-Spatial achieves the highest average score of 65.64%, ahead of 62.79% for Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, and ranks first on seven of the twelve benchmarks ( Table 2 ).
It also outperforms its autoregressive base model on all twelve benchmarks, including gains of 22.89 percentage points on RoboSpatial VQA and 12.50 points on RefSpatial-Bench.
These improvements span both spatial question answering and point localization.
For length estimation, the final model reaches an MAE of 0.103 m on the VST-300 development set.
On an NVIDIA B200 GPU, MJev-Spatial also achieves the lowest mean query latency, 160.6 ms, yielding a 2.5 × \times speedup over the fastest autoregressive baseline and a 5.6 × \times speedup over its base model ( Table 11 ).
The combination of the highest average score and lowest mean latency gives MJev-Spatial the strongest performance–latency trade-off among the compared models ( Figure 1 ).
These results support our System 1 approach to spatial understanding: adapting pretrained multimodal knowledge into direct classification decisions that deliver both strong prediction quality and fast responses.

它还在所有12个基准上都超过了其自动递减基准模型,包括机器人空间VQA的22.89个百分点和RefSpatial-Bench的12.50分。
这些改进既包括空间问题答案,也包括点定位。
对于长度估计,最终模型在VST-300开发集上达到0.103米的MAE.
在NVIDIA B200 GPU上,MJev-Spatial还实现了最小的平均查询时空,160.6 ms,比自递性基线快2.5×分,比基数快5.6×分(表11).

这些成果支持我们系统1的空间理解方法:将经过预先培训的多模式知识纳入直接的分类决定,既能提供强有力的预测质量,又能作出快速反应。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en:
We next examine the design choices that make direct classification effective across spatial tasks.
The studies follow the prediction process: we first assess the shared candidate-scoring mechanism, then examine how numerical discretization and visual refinement provide the precision needed for value and point prediction.
We further study how decoding adapts these predictions to different output requirements, including multiple points.
This progression connects the common classifier to the task-specific decisions behind the final model.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来将审查使直接分类在空间任务中产生效力的设计选择。
这些研究遵循了预测过程:我们首先评估共同的考生评分机制,然后审查数字盘分化和视觉改进如何提供价值和分数预测所需的精确度。
我们进一步研究解码如何使这些预测适应不同的输出要求,包括多点.
这一进展将通用分类器与最终模型背后的任务特定决定相连接.

blocks.en:
We compare native Q/K scoring with a typical linear classifier and a KEV ( Palmer, 2026 ) pointer using newly initialized projections to assess whether adding a prediction head improves over reusing the pretrained projections ( Table 3 ).
The results show no consistent winner across tasks: native Q/K achieves the best RefSpatial accuracy, 51.00%, and the lowest length-estimation MAE, 0.3341 m, while the position classifier performs better on Where2Place and RoboSpatial pointing.
We therefore favor native Q/K for its minimal changes to the pretrained architecture: it reuses the existing projections without adding a prediction head or new trainable parameters.
It also has the fewest trainable parameters and the lowest measured training cost among the three variants.
blocks.zh:
我们用新初始化的预测来比较原生Q/K分数与典型的线性分数器和KEV(Palmer, 2026)指针,以评估增加一个预测头是否比再使用预受训练的预测更有利(表3).
结果显示,在各项任务之间没有一致的赢家:原生Q/K实现最好的RefSpace精确度51.00%,最小的长度估计MAE为0.3341米,而位置分类器在Where2Place和RoboSpatial指向上表现较好.
因此,我们赞成本地Q/K对预训架构的最小变化:它重新使用现有的预测,而不增加一个预测头或新的可训练参数。
在三种变体中,它也拥有最少的可培训参数和最低的计量培训费用。

Keeping the same coarse intervals, we reduce the positive leaf cells from 960 to 216 by replacing 32 fine bins per interval with the 4/8-bin design.

Point prediction requires both a precise output representation and enough visual detail to distinguish nearby locations.
We investigate whether original-image context or reused features can replace fresh crop encodings while retaining localization accuracy.
Removing crops from the trained model reduces RefSpatial accuracy from 51.00% to 9.00%; training a model without crops recovers 46.50%, showing the importance of adapting training to the chosen visual input ( Tables 18 and 5 ).
Crop re-encoding nevertheless achieves the highest RefSpatial and Point-Bench scores among the four visual strategies, reaching 51.00% and 56.84%, respectively.
Replaying visual tokens or attention K/V does not recover these scores.
We therefore retain crop re-encoding to supply the local visual evidence needed by successive region decisions.

然而,作物再编码在四种视觉策略中取得了最高的RefSpatial和Point-Bench分数,分别达到51.00%和56.84%。
重放视觉符号或注意K/V不会恢复这些分数.
因此,我们保留作物重新编码,以提供连续区域决定所需的当地视觉证据。

blocks.en:
We also evaluate direct visual-token pointing, which replaces the three-stage hierarchy with a single decision over the original image’s visual tokens.
For the native Q/K model, connected-component decoding improves counting success from 12.76% with argmax to 32.14%.
Selecting the decoder according to the task raises the overall Point-Bench score from 50.76% with argmax to 54.63% ( Table 19 ).
The hierarchical crop model retains stronger RefSpatial and Point-Bench performance ( Table 20 ), while these results show how adapting the decoder makes the one-stage alternative more effective.

根据任务选择解码器,将总分从50.76%的正比分提高到54.63%(表19)。
分级作物模式保留了更强的RefSpatial和Point-Bench性能(表20),而这些结果显示了如何调整解码器使一个阶段的替代品更加有效。

blocks.en:
Finally, we test whether the same point-classification hierarchy can recover multiple targets without additional training.
Replacing repeated continue/stop decisions with a spatial probability tree raises Point-Bench counting success from 19.39% to 38.78% ( Table 21 ).
Root pruning retains the same success rate while reducing the mean number of decision nodes from 91 to 51.10 and inference time from 4.716 to 2.638 seconds per question, a 1.79 × \times speedup.
The default 10% peak threshold achieves 38.78% success, compared with 30.10% and 37.24% at thresholds of 5% and 20%, respectively ( Table 22 ).
The shared classifier thus extends to multi-point prediction through its decision tree, with pruning reducing the cost of this extension.

最后,我们检验同一分级等级能否在没有额外训练的情况下恢复多个目标.

默认的10%的高峰门槛达到38.78%的成功率,而最低门槛分别为5%和20%,分别为30.10%和37.24%(表22)。
因此,共享分类器通过其决策树延伸至多点预测,同时减少这一扩展的费用。

blocks.en: 4.4 Training Speed
blocks.zh: 4.4 培训速度

blocks.en:
The scheduling study tests whether similar-length microbatches and cross-GPU workload balancing reduce the cost of training heterogeneous spatial questions.
Four fresh runs use the same historical 72K corpus, global batch 256, microbatch eight, four accumulation steps, and eight L20D GPUs.
Each runs 100 updates; after eight warmup updates, the measurement window contains the same 23,552 QA.
The comparison holds the model and training computation fixed apart from scheduling.

Local length grouping raises throughput from 99.06 to 116.91 QA/s and reduces padding from 35.17% to 12.36%, but increases mean gradient-ready spread from 115.0 to 306.6 ms ( Table 6 ).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
MJev-Spatial investigates a System One approach to spatial understanding: using pretrained multimodal knowledge to make direct spatial decisions without generating answer text.
Options, numerical values, and image locations share a candidate-classification mechanism, with hierarchical refinement providing numerical and spatial precision and tree expansion extending point prediction without further training.
An audited 12.3M-QA corpus and joint stage supervision support training across these tasks; length grouping and cross-GPU balancing improve throughput by 30.8% in a controlled eight-GPU study.
The final Qwen3.5-4B-based model achieves the highest overall score, leads seven of twelve reported metrics among eight evaluated models, and exceeds its local autoregressive base model on all twelve.
Its mean batch-one query latency is 160.6 ms across the twelve benchmarks, giving 2.5 × \times and 5.6 × \times speedups over the fastest autoregressive baseline and the base model under the reported timing protocol.
Together with the controlled design studies, these results support direct candidate decisions as a viable approach to the spatial tasks studied here.
blocks.zh:
MJev-Spatial调查了一种系统一的空间理解方法:利用预先训练的多模式知识在不生成答案文本的情况下直接作出空间决策.
选项、数字值和图像位置共享一个候选分类机制,分级改进提供数字和空间精确度,树木扩张延伸点预测,无需进一步培训。
经审计的12.3M-QAA和跨这些任务的联合阶段监督支持培训;长度分组和跨GPU在受控的8-GPU研究中将吞吐量提高30.8%.
最终基于Quen3.5-4B的模型实现最高的整体分数,在被评价的8个模型中领先了7个12个已上报的度量衡,并超越了所有12个模型的本地自旋基准模型.
其平均批次一的查询间隔为160.6ms,跨越了12个基准,给出了2.5×分时数和5.6×分时数的速度,超过了所报告时间协议下最快的自旋基线和基准模型.
这些结果与受控设计研究一起,支持了直接的候选决定,作为完成这里所研究的空间任务的可行方法.

The frozen vision encoder ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) and merger embed each image into the language sequence, and the first 31 language layers contextualize the whole causal row.
The state at an option-end marker then summarizes that option in the context of the image, the question, and the preceding options, while the state at the decision marker sees all current candidates.
Changing an option therefore changes its representation rather than the interpretation of a fixed classifier slot, which lets the candidate set vary freely across questions.

blocks.en: Appendix B Data Conversion and Validation
blocks.zh: 附录B 数据转换和验证

blocks.en: B.1 From Spatial Annotations to Classification Supervision
blocks.zh: B.1 从空间说明到分类监督

blocks.en:
We convert spatial annotations from the training collection curated for Molmo2-ER ( Fang et al., 2026 ) , which contains 5M source records and 21.1M QA.
The annotations originate from RefSpatial ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) , SAT ( Ray et al., 2025 ) , SenseNova-SI ( Cai et al., 2026 ) , VSI-590K ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , VST-P ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , and RoboPoint ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) ; Table 7 reports their contributions to the final corpus.
Each accepted QA contains the ordered images, question, answer type, candidates, and target.
Supplied options retain their semantic content, numerical labels determine the target intervals, and point coordinates determine the target regions and training crops.
Source answers and rationales are excluded from model inputs.
blocks.zh:
我们从Molmo2-ER(Fang et al., 2026)的训练收集中转换空间说明,其中包含5M源记录和21.1M QA.
注解出自Respatial (Zhou等,2025a),SAT (Ray等,2025.),SenseNova-SI (Cai等,2026.),VSI-590K (Yang等,2025a.),VST-P (Yang等,2025b.),和RoboPoint (Yan等,2024.);表7报告了他们对最终委托书的贡献.
每个被接受的QA包含命令的图像,问答类型,候选对象,以及目标.
被应用选项保留其语义内容,数字标签决定目标间隔,点坐标决定目标区域和培训作物.
原始答案和理由被排除在模型投入之外。

blocks.en:
Supplied text and image options are retained when exactly one candidate matches the source answer.
Questions with ambiguous matches or unresolved image bindings are excluded.
Question text, including comparison clauses, is preserved separately from the candidate descriptions.
blocks.zh:
当一个候选人与源答案完全吻合时,保留所应用的文本和图像选项。
包含模棱两可的匹配或未解决的图像绑定的问题不在此列.
问题案文,包括比较条款,与备选说明分开保留。

blocks.en:
When no explicit answer menu applies, the requested quantity determines the task and units.
Length targets are converted to meters, counts are exact integers in 0–1023, and angle direction follows the question.
We accept a scalar target only when its value and unit are unambiguous.
Ranges, inequalities, conflicting quantities, and unsupported area or volume answers are excluded.
blocks.zh:
在未应用明确答案菜单时,要求的数量决定任务和单位.
长度目标被转换为米,计数是0–1023的精确整数,角度方向跟随问题.
我们只有在目标的价值和单位明确的情况下,才接受这一目标。
范围、不平等、数量相冲突以及无依据的地区或数量答案均排除在外。

blocks.en:
Single-point labels with a verified coordinate convention are normalized to the original image.
Multiple-point lists, region-only annotations, unresolved image bindings, and examples with more than five source images are excluded.
Boolean and relation labels use fixed candidate vocabularies when no supplied answer menu applies.
RoboPoint-spatial ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) contributes no final QA because its available multi-point or region supervision is outside this adaptation.

带有经核实的坐标会话的单点标签与原始图像正常化.
多点列表,仅区域说明,未解决的图像绑定,以及有5个以上来源图像的例子被排除在外.
布尔和关系标签在未提供答案菜单时使用固定候选人词汇表。

blocks.en:
We compare 245 converted numerical QA with their source annotations and semantically review 75 cases.

有针对性地审查66 574份有已知选择权转换问题的质量保证,收回65 902份质量保证,排除672起模棱两可的案件。

We remove adapter-added option labels and answer-format instructions while preserving the meaning of candidate text.
This cleanup affects 15.2M candidate texts across 6.5M QA; the final corpus contains 12,304,058 QA.
We check 3,422 nontrivial cleanup cases against their source annotations and validate 3,427 rendered training examples across five sources and 200 display categories, including teacher-forced crops.

Another 256 pointing questions are flagged for coordinate-wording review.

blocks.en: B.3 Duplicate Filtering and Evaluation Separation

blocks.en:
We exclude invalid images and training examples whose images exactly match public evaluation images or satisfy a conservative near-duplicate criterion.
Near-duplicates require a 64-bit difference-hash ( Krawetz, 2013 ) Hamming distance at most 2, aspect ratios within 1%, and mean absolute RGB difference at most 6 on 8 × 8 8\times 8 thumbnails.
These checks target nearly identical images; they do not establish physical-scene or video-neighbor independence.

blocks.en:
To reduce padding, sequences within each global optimizer batch are sorted by expanded length L q L_{q} into microbatches of eight.
To limit workload imbalance across devices, a longest-work-first assignment ( Graham, 1969 ) distributes these microbatches across eight ranks by the cost C ⁡ ( B ) = | B | ​ max q ∈ B ​ L q + 0.25 ​ ∑ q ∈ B V q , C(B)=|B|\max_{q\in B}L_{q}+0.25\sum_{q\in B}V_{q}, (19) where V q V_{q} measures visual-token work, and each scheduling round gives one microbatch to each rank.
The recipe uses no cross-update buffer, concatenated QA sequences, training prefix cache, or image deduplication.
With W W workers, each microbatch uses W / N actual W/N_{\rm actual} times its weighted loss sum, so averaging across workers ( Li et al., 2020 ) recovers Equation 7 .

blocks.en:
We test whether a pretrained candidate scorer can replace an added classification head while retaining competitive spatial performance.
The controlled comparison evaluates three ways to convert contextual representations into candidate scores.
A position classifier applies LayerNorm ( Ba et al., 2016 ) and a 32-output linear layer to the decision state; its outputs refer to candidate slots.
A KEV pointer completes the language backbone and projects the decision and option-end states with two newly initialized affine 2560 → 256 2560\rightarrow 256 maps, scoring their dot product divided by 256 \sqrt{256} .
It adds 1,311,232 parameters and explicitly represents candidate content.
The native mean model instead reuses the final attention projections at the earlier boundary in Section 3.2 .
The comparison therefore tests both representation source and the amount of downstream computation retained.
blocks.zh:
我们测试一个经过预先训练的考生评分员是否能够替换一个附加的分级头,同时保留竞争性的空间性能.
对照比较评价了将背景表述转化为候选人分数的三种方法。
一个职位分类器对决定状态应用了TyleNorm(Ba等,2016年)和一个32输出的线性层;其输出指候选位.
KEV指针完成语言主干线,并预测决定和选项端状态,有两个新初始化的同位素 2560 ~ 256 2560\正方形 256 地图,将其点值产品除以 256\sqrt{ 256}.
它增加了1 311 232个参数,并明确代表了候选内容。
原生平均模型重新使用第3.2节中较早边界的最后注意力预测。
因此,这一比较检验了表述来源和保留下游计算的数量。

blocks.en:
Table 3 is the primary matched readout comparison.
Native mean improves over the linear classifier by 1.58 points on CV-Bench, 7.72 on RoboSpatial VQA, and 2.00 on RefSpatial; MAE falls by 8.93%.
The gains come with losses of 8.01 points on Where2Place and 3.28 on RoboSpatial pointing.
Relative to KEV, native mean improves RefSpatial and length error but is not uniformly better on choice tasks.
Its retained parameter count and measured training cost are lower.
These results support pretrained candidate scoring as a compact shared design; they do not establish that its scoring formula alone causes every gain, since templates and initialization source remain architecture-dependent.

On RoboSpatial VQA, compatibility rises from 35.24 to 52.38, compared with a smaller configuration gain from 78.05 to 83.74.

This difference accounts for 5.61 of the 6.01-point macro gap; the mean across the other four categories differs by only about 0.50 points.
The shortfall is concentrated in estimating and separating multiple targets, rather than a uniform loss of single-point localization.
The training mixture provides mostly one point per example, and the multi-point decoder is composed from conditional single-point decisions.

blocks.en: F.1 Visual Refinement: New Pixels, Replayed Features, or Direct Tokens?
blocks.zh: F.1 视觉完善:新像素,再播放地物,还是直接托肯斯?.

blocks.en:
Hierarchical point classification must preserve enough visual detail to distinguish increasingly small regions.
We therefore separate three questions: whether crop-trained weights can operate without crops, whether matching training to a cheaper visual input recovers quality, and whether spatial candidates should be text regions or visual tokens.
All learned variants start from the same official Qwen base.
Training QA, updates, optimizer, and per-QA loss normalization are held fixed; visual computation is an intended variable, so the runs do not have equal FLOPs.
blocks.zh:
分级点分类必须保留足够的视觉细节,以区分越来越小的区域.
因此,我们把三个问题分开:作物训练的重量能否不种植作物而运作,将训练与更便宜的视觉输入相匹配是否能恢复质量,空间考生是否应该是文字区或视觉标志.
所有已学习的变种都从同名官克文起.
训练QA,更新,优化器,以及每QA损失常态被固定;可视化计算是预定变量,因此跑道没有等同的FLOP.

blocks.en:
The inference-only intervention keeps three nine-way textual decisions but removes both appended pixel crops.
RefSpatial drops from 51.00 to 9.00, Where2Place from 59.98 to 32.00, and RoboSpatial pointing from 62.30 to 20.49 ( Table 18 ).
Adding an original-image hybrid prefix cache leaves these aggregate scores unchanged.
The immediate loss is therefore not repaired by reusing the original context more efficiently.
However, this comparison changes both visual detail and the input distribution seen during training; it cannot determine the potential of a separately trained no-crop model.
blocks.zh:
仅以推论为主的干预保留了3个9行的文字决定,但移除了两个附加的像素收成.
参考空间从51.00降至9.00,Where2Place从59.98降至32.00,RoboSpatial指向62.30至20.49(表18)。
添加一个原生-图像混合前缀缓存会让这些汇总分数保持不变.
因此,无法通过更有效地使用原上下文来修复直接损失。
然而,这种比较既改变了视觉细节,也改变了培训期间看到的输入分布;无法确定单独培训的无作物模式的潜力。

blocks.en:
Table 18: Fixed crop-trained native-mean checkpoint: removing new pixel crops, with and without a reusable original-image prefix.
All three textual grid rounds remain.
The crop control was not timed in this run.

表18 固定作物训练本土-正名检查站:拆除新像素作物,有和无可再使用的原相前缀.

blocks.en:
The original-image variant removes crop placeholders during training as well as inference, while retaining the selected rectangle and region options in text.
Training still has three supervised decisions per pointing QA, and choice/scalar token sequences and targets remain unchanged.
RefSpatial recovers to 46.50 and Point-Bench macro to 52.55 ( Table 5 ).
This recovery shows that much of the inference-only collapse is an input-distribution mismatch.
The remaining gap to crop re-encoding suggests that original-image context and region text do not fully replace newly resolved local visual information in this setting.
blocks.zh:
最初的图像变体在培训和推论期间移除了作物占位符,同时保留了文字中选定的矩形和区域选项.
培训仍然有三项监督决定,选择/标语序列和目标保持不变。
RedSpatial恢复到46.50,Point-Bench宏观恢复到52.55(表5)。
这种恢复表明,大部分只推断的倒塌是输入-分配不匹配.
作物再编码的剩余缺口表明,原成像上下文和区域文本在此设定中并不完全取代新解决的地方视觉信息.

blocks.en:
The next variant encodes the original pixels once per forward and appends existing merged visual tokens whose spatial supports have positive overlap with the selected ROI.
Tokens retain row-major source order and their original multimodal rotary positions; there is no interpolation to a new fixed grid.
This exposes region-focused representations without new pixel encoding.
Boundary tokens may still include content outside the ROI, and copying cannot recover detail absent from the first visual tokenization.
blocks.zh:
下个变体每向前一回编码了原始像素,并附加了现有的被合并的可视符号,其空间支持与所选ROI有正重叠.
托肯斯保留了行主源顺序及其原来的多模式回转位置;没有插入到一个新的固定网格上.
这暴露出没有新像素编码的以区域为重点的表示.
边界标志可能仍然包括ROI以外的内容,而复制无法从第一次视觉标志化中恢复细节.

blocks.en:
A second replay variant appends the same visual tokens but replaces their keys and values in complete full-attention layers L4–L28 with differentiably gathered K/V from original-image positions after rotary encoding.
Queries, gates, residuals, and FFNs execute normally.
Source K/V remain in the current computation graph, and the original-image prefix precedes all question histories.
blocks.zh:
第二回放变体附加了同一种可视化符号,但在完全全心全意的L4-L28层中替换了它们的键和值,取而代之的是旋转编码后不同地从原始图像位置所收集的K/V.
查询、大门、剩余部分和FFN通常执行。
来源 K/ V 保留在当前计算图中,原始图像前缀会先于所有的问题历史.

blocks.en:
The matched comparison is reported in Table 5 .
Neither replay scheme closes the overall gap to crop re-encoding.
ViT replay reaches 47.00 RefSpatial and 52.87 Point-Bench, only slightly above matched original-image training.
KV replay improves Where2Place to 68.95 but decreases RoboSpatial pointing to 54.92 and increases length MAE to 0.4097 m.
Choice and numerical scores also change despite identical non-point inputs, consistent with interactions through the jointly trained backbone.
These outcomes support crop re-encoding as the final common representation.
blocks.zh:
表5报告了相应的比较情况。
无论是复放还是复放计划,都无法弥合作物再编码的总体差距。
VIT回放达到47.00 RefSpatial和52.87 Point-Bench,仅略高于原生图像训练.
KV回放改进了Where2Place到68.95,但将RoboSpatial指向54.92并增加长度MAE到0.4097米.
尽管非分数输入相同,但选择和分数也会改变,这与通过联合培训的骨干进行的互动是一致的。
这些成果支持作物重新编码作为最终的共同代表。

blocks.en:
We train two further models, KEV and native mean, whose point candidates are the original image’s merged visual tokens in the language sequence .
The query is the question-end decision state; keys use the same language-side projections as their respective readout.
Let H ′ = H / s H^{\prime}=H/s and W ′ = W / s W^{\prime}=W/s denote the dimensions of the merged visual-token grid; each cell is a candidate.
Cell ( r , c ) (r,c) decodes to ( ( c + 1 / 2 ) / W ′ , ( r + 1 / 2 ) / H ′ ) ((c+1/2)/W^{\prime},(r+1/2)/H^{\prime}) in original normalized coordinates.

让H ' = H / s H ' prime * * H / s 和 W ' = W / s ' prime * * W / s 表示合并的可视-托接网格的维度;每个单元格都是候选.

blocks.en:
Point training uses one decision.
Ground-truth points are mapped to occupied cells by floor-and-clamp, with equal target mass across distinct occupied cells.
Repeated points in one cell do not multiply its weight, and target masks do not enlarge the positive set.
This preserves one unit of loss per QA while changing both the spatial representation and number of stages.
The one-pass method removes crop encoding, but its grid resolution depends on image aspect ratio and token budget; it cannot resolve two instances that share the same visual cell.
blocks.zh:
点培训使用一个决定。
地面真相点按地平面和地平面图绘制到被占用的细胞,各不同被占用细胞的目标质量相等。
一个细胞中重复的分数不会使其重量相乘,目标口罩不会扩大正数组.
这在改变空间表现和阶段数量的同时,保留了每质量评估损失的一个单位。
单行道方法可以去除收件编码,但其网格分辨率取决于图像宽比和符号预算;它不能解决两个共享同视觉单元格的情况.

blocks.en:
We decode each saved visual-logit grid with global argmax, global connected components, and a task-based rule.
The latter uses argmax for RefSpatial and non-counting Point-Bench, and components for Where2Place, RoboSpatial, and counting.
The rule was specified after the first decoder comparison; all three columns for a model share weights and logits, with no extra training or forward passes for the task-based recombination.
blocks.zh:
我们解码了每个被保存的可视记录网格 带有全局的正方形、全局连接的组件和基于任务的规则。
后者使用阿格马克斯来进行RefSpatial和不计分点-Bench,以及用于Where2Place,RoboSpatial和计分的组件.
该规则在第一次解码器比较后被指定;一个模型的三列都分享了权重和对数,没有额外的训练或任务重组的前行通行证.

blocks.en:
The decoder ablation explains why a universal multi-point policy is unsuitable ( Table 19 ).
For native visual tokens, components improve counting from 12.76 to 32.14 but reduce overall Point-Bench macro from 50.76 to 32.71: extra peaks harm tasks that expect one point.
Task-based routing restores the single-point categories and reaches 54.63.
It still trails hierarchical mean on RefSpatial (45.50 versus 51.00) and Point-Bench (54.63 versus 56.74).
Cross-task effects also differ between KEV and native readouts ( Table 20 ); for example, native visual-token training improves MMSI but worsens length MAE.
The experiments favor retaining hierarchical crops for the final model.
blocks.zh:
解码器停用解释了为什么通用多点政策不合适(表19)。
就原生视觉标志而言,组件的计数从12.76个改进为32.14个,但整体点-奔克宏从50.76个减少为32.71个: 额外峰值的伤害任务需要1分。
基于任务的路由恢复了单点类别,并达到了54.63.
它在RefSpatial(45.50对51.00)和Point-Bench(54.63对56.74)上仍然遵循等级平均值.
跨任务效应在KEV和原生读取(表20)之间也有所不同;例如,原生的可视化读取训练改进了MMSI,但使MAE长度恶化.
实验倾向于为最终模型保留分级收成.

blocks.en: F.2 Multi-Point Decoding: Probability Trees versus Stop Decisions
blocks.zh: F.2 多点解码:概率 树与停止决定

blocks.en:
The first counting extension repeatedly asks a continue/stop choice and, when continuing, invokes single-point prediction with the already selected coordinates in the prompt.
This composes existing interfaces without training on exhaustive point-set completion.
It relies on coverage and stopping behavior from a model trained primarily on single targets.
On all 196 Point-Bench counting questions, it reaches 19.39% official success and count MAE 11.64.
A small set of long overproduced sequences inflates the mean predicted count to 10.48 even though many other examples undercount.
blocks.zh:
第一个计数扩展多次要求继续/停止选择,在继续时,使用已经选中的坐标引用了单点预测.
这构成现有接口,但没有进行关于完成完整点集的培训。
它依赖主要接受单一目标培训的模型的覆盖面和停止行为。
在所有196个点-本奇计数问题上,它都达到了19.39%的官方成功率并计入了MAE 11.64.
一小组长长的多产序列将平均预测数膨胀到10.48,尽管许多其他例子都低估了。

blocks.en:
The probability-tree alternative in Section 3.1 measures the spatial mass of all potential paths and extracts components without a learned stop query.
Both full and root-pruned trees reach 38.78% success and 46.43% exact-count accuracy in the dedicated paired experiment ( Table 21 ).
Root pruning reduces mean node count from 91 to 51.10, a 43.84% reduction, while omitting only 0.588% probability mass on average.
Measured per-question time decreases from 4.716 to 2.638 seconds, a 1.79 × \times ratio under this execution setup.
blocks.zh:
第3.1节中的概率-树替代测量所有潜在路径的空间质量,并提取组件而无需学习的停止查询.
全树和倒根树在专用对生实验中都达到38.78%的成功率和46.43%的精确计算准确率(表21)。
根推倒将平均节点计数从91降至51.10,减幅为43.84%,而平均只省去0.588%的概率质量.
按每问题计算的时间从4.716秒降至2.638秒,在这个执行设置下为1.79×\时之比.

blocks.en:
The two modes are separately executed, alternate order by question index, and use untimed warmup, batches of 16 nodes, eight GPUs, visual deduplication, and no shared language prefix.
Timings include processing and GPU computation but exclude loading, warmup, and saving.
Predicted counts agree on 195/196 questions and success on all 196.
Shadow pruning of the saved full-tree logits changes no counts; the one count discrepancy in the actual paired runs is therefore associated with changed numerical execution rather than omitting a root region alone.
The later consolidated benchmark rerun has slightly different full-tree scores and timings; its own values are retained in the overall matrix instead of replacing this paired control.
blocks.zh:
两种模式分别执行,按问题索引交替排列,并使用未定时取暖,分批取出16个节点,8个GPU,可视分解,没有共享语言前缀.
时间安排包括处理和GPU计算,但不包括加载,取暖,并保存.
预期的计数就195/196年的问题达成一致,所有196年都取得了成功。
被保存的全树日志的阴影浏览不会改变计数;因此,实际对等运行中的一个计数差异与数字执行的改变有关,而不是仅省略一个根区域。

blocks.en: Appendix G Extended Numerical Studies
blocks.zh: 附录G 扩展数字研究

blocks.en: G.1 Numerical Design: Coverage, Granularity, and Decoding
blocks.zh: G.1 数字设计:覆盖面、外观和解码

blocks.en:
Numerical discretization has two sources of error: representing a true value with a finite cell center, and predicting the correct cell from the image.
The following experiments measure these separately.
Codebook candidates are designed from training labels, and the 4/8 codebook below is used for the final model.
All learned comparisons, however, retain the old 72K-QA gradient-training budget, including only 22K length examples.
blocks.zh:
数盘化有两个出错源:用有限度的细胞中心来表示正值,从图像来预测正确的细胞.
以下实验分别测量这些.
代码表考生从培训标签中设计出,下面的4/8代码表用于最终模型.
然而,所有学到的比较都保留了原有的72K-QA梯度培训预算,只包括了22K长度的例子.

blocks.en:
The historical codebook has 12 positive intervals ending at 200 m, two special roots, and 32 fine cells per positive interval.
It covers all old 72K length labels but overflows on 12K expanded-corpus labels.
The scale audit compares uniform, log, quantile, task-specific, and hierarchical allocations on all 1.6M accepted lengths ( Table 25 ).
These are label encode/decode oracles, assuming every classification decision is correct.
blocks.zh:
历史法典有12个正间隔,以200米结束,有2个特有根,每个正间隔有32个细细胞.
它覆盖了所有旧的72K长度的标签,但在12K的扩充型公司标签上溢出.
规模审计对所有1.6M认可长度的统一、对数、量化、特定任务和分级分配进行了比较(表25)。
这些是标签编码/解码甲骨文,假设每个分类决定是正确的.

blocks.en:
Uniform 960-cell spacing up to 16,384 m gives MAE 6.4545 m because most labels are short.
Quantile spacing improves the proportion within 1 cm to 80.78%, yet produces MAE 4.2371 m and maximum error 3935.55 m: a dense central distribution leaves the sparse tail poorly represented.
Shared log allocations balance these scales more effectively.
The 30-by-32 two-stage log1p proposal reaches 0.0391 m oracle MAE and 21.39 m maximum error, compared with 1.6548 and 8320.10 m for the historical codebook.
Task-specific log allocation offers a small average improvement but introduces question-type routing and poorly supported rare categories (e.g., only five diameter and four thickness labels).
We therefore keep a shared length codebook and the existing linear within-interval decoder.
blocks.zh:
统一960-细胞间距可达16,384米给MAE 6.4545米,因为大多数标签都短.
量子间距在1厘米至80.78%范围内改善比例,但产生MAE 4.2371米和最大误差3935.55米:密集的中央分布使稀疏的尾巴代表差.
共享日志分配更有效地平衡这些比额表。
30相32双相对一p建议达到0.0391米甲骨文MAE和21.39米最大出错,而历史编码本的误差为1.6548和8320.10米.
任务特定的日志分配提供了小的平均改进,但引入了问题类型的路由和支持不足的稀有类别(例如只有5个直径和4个厚度标签).
因此,我们保留一个共享的长度代码簿和现有的线性间距解码器.

blocks.en:
A new L32 mean model uses 30 positive log1p intervals and 32 fine cells per interval (960 leaves), preserving all other 72K settings and the exact non-numerical stage texts and mappings.
On those training labels, oracle MAE falls from 0.006591 to 0.003891 m and P99 error from 0.045625 to 0.023542 m, but worst-case error rises from 0.7475 to 0.9800 m.
The new numerical candidate text adds 527.43 tokens on average; the longest checked scalar sequence is 2,068 tokens, within the 4,096-token budget.
Coverage and average quantization improve at a real input-cost increase.
blocks.zh:
一个新的L32平均模型使用30正对数1p间隔和每间隔32个细格(960个叶子),保留了所有其他的72K设置以及准确的非数字相位文本和映射.
在这些训练标签上,甲骨文MAE从0.006591米降至0.003891米,P99错误从0.045625米降至0.023542米,但最坏情况错误从0.7475米增至0.9800米。
新的候选数字文本平均增加了527.43个符号;最长的被检查的标尺序列是2 068个符号,在4 096个托肯预算范围内。
覆盖面和平均数量随着实际投入成本的增加而增加。

blocks.en:
The learned model reduces VST-300 MAE from 0.335420 to 0.327732 m, only 2.29%, and lowers all five classification benchmark scores.
The much larger oracle gain does not translate directly into prediction accuracy.
This motivates reducing fine-stage difficulty rather than adding still more representational resolution.
blocks.zh:
所学模式将VST-300 MAE从0.335420降至0.327732米,只有2.29%,并降低了所有五个分类基准分数.
更大的甲骨文增益并不能直接转化为预测精度.
这鼓励减少细小阶段的困难,而不是增加更多的代表性决议。

blocks.en:
The 4/8 design in Equation 3 keeps the same coarse intervals and range but reduces positive leaves from 960 to 216.
In the full length census, 108K positive labels use four fine candidates, 1.5M use eight, and 382 terminate at zero.
Both the 32-fine and 4/8 representations meet the specified max ⁡ ( 1 ​ cm , 5 % ​ y ) \max(1\,\mathrm{cm},5\%\,y) oracle tolerance on every audited label, with no overflow.
Coarser cells increase oracle MAE from 0.039102 to 0.154041 m and maximum error from 21.39 to 59.55 m.
The 4/8 codebook exchanges quantization resolution for a smaller candidate set.
blocks.zh:
方程式3中4/8的设计保持了相同的粗放间隔和范围,但将正叶从960个减少到了216个.
在全长普查中,108K正标使用4个精细候选,1.5M使用8个,382个以零结束.
32-fine和4/8的表示都符合每个被审计标签上指定的最大分量( 1 cm, 5% y )\max( 1\, mathrm{cm}, 5\%\, y) 甲骨文可容忍度, 没有溢出 。
相干细胞将甲骨文MAE从0.039102增加到0.154041米,最大误差从21.39米增加到59.55米.
4/8代码簿交换量化分辨率为更小的候选集.

blocks.en:
A second independently initialized model changes only these fine cardinalities.
Choice, point, count, and angle implementations remain fixed; no length batching optimization is introduced in this quality comparison.
The estimated scalar sequence length is bounded by 1,514 tokens.
Training takes 1,369.33 seconds versus 1,604.98 for the prior 30-by-32 run under their recorded timing scopes.
The shorter candidate representation is consistent with lower work, although these single-run training times are not a dedicated timing ablation.
blocks.zh:
第二个独立初始化的模型只改变这些精细的核心.
选择、点数、计数和角度执行保持不变;本质量比较中没有引入长度分批优化。
估计的斯卡尔序列长度以1,514个符相接.
培训需要1 369.33秒,而前30分32分的训练需要1 604.98秒。
候选人任职时间较短与工作较少是一致的,尽管这些单人培训时间并不是专门的时间间隔。

blocks.en:
The 4/8 argmax model achieves MAE 0.320207 m, 4.54% below the historical control and 2.30% below 30-by-32.
Errors within 10 cm increase to 59.00%.
All nine public primary scores improve relative to 30-by-32; relative to the historical codebook, SAT and the four pointing scores improve, while four other classification scores remain slightly lower.
The historical codebook still has better mean relative error (24.64% versus 29.03%), emphasizing that MAE and relative accuracy favor different parts of the value distribution.
blocks.zh:
4/8相克马斯模型实现MAE 0.320207米,比历史控制低4.54%,比30比32低2.30%.
10cm以内出错增加至59.00%.
所有9个公用初等分数都比30比32有所改善;相较于历史代号本,SAT和4个分数都有所改善,而其他4个分级分数仍然略低.
历史编码本仍然有较好的相对误差(24.64%对29.03%),强调MAE和相对准确性有利于数值分布的不同部分.

The representation comparison includes a 384-cell shared logarithmic control matching the historical positive-cell budget and several 960-cell allocations.
The selected hierarchical proposal differs from a globally logarithmic leaf grid: its roots are log1p-spaced, but each root’s fine cells are linear.
The actual final 216-cell variant is documented in Sections 3.1 and 4.3 .
All oracle labels come from the expanded training corpus, not from evaluation targets.

表述比较包括384个细胞共享对数控制,与历史正细胞预算和数个960个细胞分配相匹配.

blocks.en: Appendix H Training Efficiency Diagnostics
blocks.zh: 附录H 培训效率诊断

blocks.en: H.1 Length Grouping Separates Padding from Rank Imbalance
blocks.zh: H.1 长度分组与排名失衡分离

blocks.en:
The final scheduling mechanism is defined in Section C.3 .
Its performance study holds global batch 256, microbatch 8, four accumulation steps, eight L20D GPUs, the old 72K data/codebook, and the timing instrumentation fixed.
Four fresh runs each process 100 updates and 25,600 QA: original order, local length grouping, global grouping with rank balancing, and global balancing with a 128-QA buffer.
The last 92 updates contain the same 23,552 measured QA; the first eight are excluded for warmup.
The buffer is drained at both measurement boundaries, and slow steps remain in the timing record.
blocks.zh:
C.3节规定了最后时间安排机制。
其性能研究持有全球第256批,微批8,4个积分步骤,8个L20D GPU,旧的72K数据/编码本,定时仪表.
每流程有4个新鲜运行100个更新和25,600个QA:原序,局部长度分组,有分级平衡的全局分组,以及有128个QA缓冲的全局平衡.
最后92个更新包含相同的23,552个测量的QA;不包括前8个热身.
缓冲器在两个测量边界被排出,计时记录中仍然有缓慢的步骤.

blocks.en: The controlled scheduling results are reported in Table 6 .
blocks.zh: 控制下的时间表结果见表6。

blocks.en:
Figure 7 : \captionlead Controlled scheduling comparison on the historical 72K corpus.
Local grouping reduces padding but leaves more rank imbalance; global grouping and balancing deliver the largest throughput gain.
A cross-update buffer reduces padding slightly further without increasing throughput.
blocks.zh:
图7 : captionlead 历史72K体表对照表
地方分组减少了铺垫,但留下了更多的排位不平衡;全球分组和平衡提供了最大的吞吐量收益。
交叉更新缓冲器在不增加吞吐量的情况下会更进一步地减少堆积.

blocks.en:
Local grouping increases throughput from 99.06 to 116.91 QA/s and reduces padding from 35.17% to 12.36%.
However, mean gradient-ready spread between ranks increases from 115.0 to 306.6 ms, and tail communication/wait time from 39.5 to 157.6 ms.
Minimizing padding independently on each rank can therefore leave unequal workloads at synchronization.
Global grouping plus balancing reduces padding to 1.77%, reduces ready-time spread relative to local grouping to 145.7 ms, and reaches 129.54 QA/s: a 30.78% throughput increase or 23.53% less measured time for equal QA volume.
Ready-time spread and tail time remain above the original-order values, so this gain reflects the combined scheduling changes rather than an isolated reduction in synchronization waiting.
blocks.zh:
当地组群的吞吐量从99.06个增加到116.91个质保/秒,并减少保值从35.17%减少到12.36%.
然而,梯度在等级之间的平均分布从115.0米增加到306.6米,尾部通信/等待时间从39.5米增加到157.6米。
因此,将每个级别上的独立加分降到最低,就可能使工作量出现不平等。
全球组合加平衡将粘合率降低到1.77%,将现成时间分布相对于本地组合被压缩到145.7 ms,并达到129.54 QA/s:30.78%的吞吐量增加或23.53%的测量时间比相等的QA体积少.
即时放行和尾接时间仍然高于原序值,因此这一增益反映了综合调度的变化而不是同步等待的孤立减少.

blocks.en:
The 128-QA buffer lowers padding to 1.03% but achieves 129.39 QA/s.
Its step-time coefficient of variation increases from 6.07% to 19.77%; even after aggregating pairs of updates into equal 512-QA units, variation is 6.30% versus 4.61% without the buffer.
This identifies diminishing returns from further packing and supports the unbuffered final layout.
Tail measurements include communication and waiting; no downstream accuracy evaluation is performed in these short runs.
blocks.zh:
128-QA缓冲被降低到1.03%,但达到了129.39QA/s.
其分步变化系数从6.07%提高到19.77%;即使在将一对更新组合成等分512-QA单位后,变化率为6.30%,没有缓冲系数的为4.61%。
这说明进一步包装的回报减少,并支持未受阻碍的最终布局。
尾部测量包括通讯和等待;在这些短时期内没有进行下游准确性评价。

blocks.zh: H.2 微型批量可行性和全球批量大小

blocks.en:
The expanded-data profile uses a fixed 12,800-QA prefix-stratified pool in the then-proposed 40/25/25/5/5 task mixture, the new 4/8 length codebook, and fresh base initialization.
All conditions use global length grouping, rank balancing, no buffer, no activation checkpointing ( Chen et al., 2016 ) , and the same precision and optimizer.
The original six-case matrix crosses global256/512 with micro8/16/32.
Its measurement window follows 4,096 warmup QA and includes 8,192 common timed QA.
Only micro8 succeeds: 111.27 QA/s at global256 and 136.07 at global512.
Micro16 and micro32 fail in both cases.
An additional global384/micro12 trial also fails.

blocks.en:
The global256/512/768 profiles use a common window of 4,608 warmup QA followed by 7,680 timed QA.
The window has 30, 15, and 10 updates for the three global batches, respectively. Table 27 reports 110.04, 135.48, and 139.78 QA/s for these batch sizes.
Peak allocated memory is approximately 242 decimal GB per rank for the successful configurations.
blocks.zh:
全球256/512/768剖面图使用共同窗口为4,608个热量QA,随后是7,680个定时QA.
窗口分别有30个,15个和10个全球分批更新. 表27报告了这些批次规模的110.04、135.48和139.78质量评估。
对于成功的配置,峰值分配的内存约为每级242个小数GB.

blocks.en:
The experiment shows that additional accumulation can raise the global batch without increasing the forward microbatch beyond its memory limit.
Global768 improves throughput over global512 by 3.17% over ten measured updates.
Moreover, all 16 executed global768 updates fall within the zero-backbone-LR period of its short schedule.
Backward computation and Adam moment updates still execute during these steps.
The final recipe therefore selects global512/micro8/accumulation8.
blocks.zh:
实验显示,额外的积累可以提高全球批量,而不会将前方的微批量增加出其内存极限.
全球768比全球512的吞吐量增加了3.17%,超过了10项计量的更新。
此外,所有16个已执行的全球768项更新都属于其短时间表的零后骨-LR期。
后向计算和亚当瞬间更新仍在这些步骤中执行.
因此,最后食谱选择了全球512/微分8/累积8。
